newsitem.title: USA: IMF board to continue talks on Sudan on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: IMF board to continue talks on Sudan on Tuesday.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund on Monday said its executive board would continue talks on Sudan's financial situation for a third day on Tuesday.

The discussions, which potentially could lead to the expulsion of the country from the Fund because of long-standing arrears on its debt, have pitted developing countries against industrial countries, international monetary sources said.
They said the developing and industrial countries were attempted to reach a compromise on action involving Sudan, one of the poorest in the world.
